target.outcome: Article target: ischemic and hemorrhagic county stroke mortality among adults 65+; fitted sensitivity: CDC all-stroke county rate among adults 65+
target.population: United States residents aged 65 years and older
target.effect_scale: Article-native additive deaths per 100,000 per 1 ug/m3; outcome-ratio presentation below is evaluated at the fitted sample mean solely for schema transport
target.exposure_assignment: Unweighted within-county mean of qualifying EPA AQS PM2.5 monitor annual arithmetic means
target.model: OLS of all-stroke age-65+ county rate on PM2.5 with state fixed effects; reduced adjustment sensitivity
target.named_outcome_source: CDC county heart disease and stroke mortality dataset (Socrata 7b9s-s8ck)
specification_evidence: ../study/article.md: Results section establishes additive linear coefficients

substitutions.reason: The successful public CDC download did not separate article outcomes or include 2020.
Public decoded monitor archive was used; it is not a population-weighted surface.

substitutions.published: Full clinical, socioeconomic, access, and park covariate set
substitutions.reason: Article-identical covariate data were not recovered in fit-ready form.
Partial monitor coverage and usable outcome overlap.

coverage.rule: EPA AQS PM2.5 monitor record with 24-hour Daily Mean metric, POC 1, local-condition units, and Observation Percent >=75; reported rather than article-specified threshold.
coverage.notes: 473 counties had qualifying EPA monitor records; 301 joined to the CDC outcome data. No individual dose or population-weighted area concentration is claimed.

blockers: No fit-ready public county ischemic/hemorrhagic outcome route was recovered.
Full article covariate adjustment was not reconstructed.
EPA monitor coverage materially reduces county coverage.

design_provenance.assignment_method: Within-county unweighted mean of qualifying EPA AQS PM2.5 monitor annual arithmetic means; county retained when monitor data were available in >=1 2016–2019 year.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Mean of annual PM2.5 local-condition 24-hour Daily Mean monitor arithmetic means (µg/m³), 2016–2019.

coverage_policy.threshold_source: AQS Observation Percent field; 75% is an explicit operational QC threshold, not article-specified
coverage_policy.evidence: EPA AQS annual archive records were retained only for Observation Percent >=75; all county and time coverage are reported.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The article requires county-level annual PM2.5. Public EPA AQS monitor records are a lawful monitor-network source, but their monitor-supported county coverage is partial and the within-county unweighted mean is an ambient monitor summary rather than a population-weighted county exposure.
evidence_basis: Validated EPA AQS annual monitor archive; PM2.5 local-condition 24-hour Daily Mean records include county FIPS, arithmetic mean, and observation coverage.
2016–2019 EPA monitor coverage produced 473 monitor counties and 301 outcome-exposure joins.

effects.label: All-stroke sensitivity: state-fixed-effect model
effects.contrast: Outcome ratio for 1 ug/m3 PM2.5 at fitted sample mean outcome (schema-transport presentation only)
